import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final long M = 1000000007;
    static long p, k;
    static int[] vis;
    static final int N = 1000005;

    static int visit(int x) {
        int cnt = 1;
        vis[(int) x] = 1;
        while (vis[(int) ((x * k) % p)] == 0) {
            x = (x * k) % p;
            cnt++;
            vis[(int) x] = 1;
        }
        return cnt;
    }

    static long powx(long a, long b) {
        long ans = 1;
        while (b > 0) {
            if ((b & 1) == 1) {
                ans = (ans * a) % p;
            }
            b >>= 1;
            a = (a * a) % p;
        }
        return ans;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        p = sc.nextLong();
        k = sc.nextLong();
        vis = new int[(int) p];
        long ans = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < p; i++) {
            if (vis[i] == 0) {
                long siz = visit(i);
                long t = powx(k, siz);
                if (t != 1 && t != 0) {
                    ans = (ans * (siz + 1)) % M;
                } else {
                    ans = (ans * p) % M;
                }
            }
        }
        if (k == 1) {
            ans = (ans * p) % M;
        }
        System.out.println(ans);
        sc.close();
    }
}
